ops.body: Preserve the intentional resource contract: plugins/codex/dispatch.go:340-358 @5be8f3a resolves plugin roots in BINRUN_PLUGIN_ROOT, invocation layout, resolved-self layout order. plugins/codex/async_test.go:369 @5be8f3a TestDispatchThroughSymlinkFindsAgentsMd depends on the resolved-source root when the invocation symlink lives elsewhere. Repointing selfPath alone to a cache would regress that path. Keep original plugin-resource identity separate from retained self-reexec identity; CI must preserve this existing regression case.
